name: Accurate Attack
summary: Accurate attack maneuver: lower effect rank by up to 5 to raise attack bonus by the same amount.

name: All-out Attack
summary: All-out attack maneuver: lower Dodge and Parry by up to 5 to raise attack bonus by the same amount.

name: Chokehold
summary: Start a restrained, grabbed foe suffocating for as long as you hold them.

name: Close Attack
summary: +1 to all close attack checks per rank (still capped by power level).

name: Defensive Attack
summary: Defensive attack maneuver: lower attack bonus by up to 5 to raise Dodge and Parry by the same amount.

name: Defensive Roll
summary: +1 Toughness per rank that counts as an active defense (lost when vulnerable or defenseless).

name: Evasion
summary: +2 circumstance bonus to Dodge checks against area effects (+5 at rank 2).

name: Fast Grab
summary: A successful unarmed hit lets you attempt a grab check as a free action.

name: Favored Environment
summary: +2 circumstance bonus to attack or active defenses (chosen each round) in one environment.

name: Grabbing Finesse
summary: Grab with Dexterity instead of Strength and stay non-vulnerable while grabbing.

name: Improved Aim
summary: Aiming doubles its circumstance bonus: +10 close or adjacent, +5 at range.

name: Improved Critical
summary: Critical threat range of a chosen attack widens by 1 per rank (to 16-20 at 4 ranks); extra ranks may go to other attacks.
max_rank_note: Cap of 4 is per attack; ranks may be split among different attacks.

name: Improved Defense
summary: +2 circumstance bonus to active defenses when you take the defend action.

name: Improved Disarm
summary: Disarm with no attack penalty and without giving the foe a chance to disarm you.

name: Improved Grab
summary: Grab one-handed, keep the other hand free, and stay non-vulnerable while grabbing.

name: Improved Hold
summary: Foes you grab take a -5 circumstance penalty to escape.

name: Improved Initiative
summary: +4 to initiative checks per rank.

name: Improved Smash
summary: No attack penalty when smashing an object held by someone else.

name: Improved Trip
summary: Trip with no penalty or counter-trip, and choose whether the foe resists with Strength or Agility.

name: Improvised Weapon
summary: Use Close Combat (Unarmed) with improvised weapons; each rank past the first adds +1 damage with them.

name: Move-by Action
summary: Split your movement before and after your standard action.

name: Power Attack
summary: Power attack maneuver: lower attack bonus by up to 5 to raise effect rank by the same amount.

name: Precise Attack
summary: Ignore cover or concealment penalties with close or ranged attacks; one close/ranged + cover/concealment pairing per rank.

name: Prone Fighting
summary: No penalty to attack while prone, and adjacent foes gain no bonus against you for it.

name: Quick Draw
summary: Draw a holstered or sheathed weapon as a free action.

name: Ranged Attack
summary: +1 to all ranged attack checks per rank (still capped by power level).

name: Redirect
summary: After tricking a foe, send their missed attack into another adjacent target.

name: Set-up
summary: Hand the benefit of a combat interaction-skill use (feint, etc.) to one ally per rank.

name: Takedown
summary: Free extra attack after taking out a minion; rank 2 lets you move to reach non-adjacent minions.

name: Throwing Mastery
summary: +1 damage per rank with thrown weapons, and harmless objects become thrown weapons.

name: Uncanny Dodge
summary: You are not vulnerable when surprised or caught off-guard.

name: Weapon Bind
summary: After successfully defending against a close weapon attack, attempt a disarm as a reaction.

name: Weapon Break
summary: After successfully defending against a close weapon attack, attack the weapon as a reaction.

name: Beginner's Luck
summary: Spend a hero point to gain effective rank 5 for the scene in a skill you have at 4 or less.

name: Inspire
summary: Once per scene, spend a hero point and a standard action to give allies +1 per rank on checks until your next round.

name: Leadership
summary: Spend a hero point and a standard action to remove dazed, fatigued, or stunned from an ally.

name: Luck
summary: Re-roll a die once per round, up to your rank in uses per session.

name: Seize Initiative
summary: Spend a hero point at the start of combat to act first.

name: Ultimate Effort
summary: Spend a hero point to treat one specific type of check as a roll of 20; take again for other checks.

name: Assessment
summary: Secret Insight check against a foe's Deception reveals how their attack and defenses compare to yours.

name: Benefit
summary: A significant perk or privilege, worth about one power point per rank, defined with the GM.

benefit_examples.name: Alternate Identity
benefit_examples.summary: A second identity with legal paperwork.

benefit_examples.name: Cipher
benefit_examples.summary: -5 per rank to Investigation checks about you.

benefit_examples.name: Diplomatic Immunity
benefit_examples.summary: Cannot be prosecuted abroad, only deported.

benefit_examples.name: Security Clearance
benefit_examples.summary: Access to classified information and facilities.

benefit_examples.name: Status
benefit_examples.summary: Special social standing such as nobility or knighthood.

benefit_examples.name: (Style) Grandmaster
benefit_examples.summary: Recognized grandmaster of a fighting style (GM may require (Style) Master first).

name: Diehard
summary: Automatically stabilize when dying.

name: Eidetic Memory
summary: Perfect recall: +5 to remember things and answer Expertise questions as if trained.

name: Equipment
summary: 5 equipment points per rank for gear, vehicles, and headquarters.

name: Extraordinary Effort
summary: Take two extra-effort benefits at once at double the fatigue cost.

name: Fearless
summary: Immune to fear effects.

name: Great Endurance
summary: +5 on checks to resist fatigue, suffocation, drowning, starvation, thirst, and heat or cold.
type_note: Advantage heading says General; the DCA Combat Advantages summary table also lists it.

name: Instant Up
summary: Stand from prone as a free action, no Acrobatics check needed.

name: Interpose
summary: Once per round, step in front of an attack that hit an ally within your movement range.

name: Minion
summary: A loyal follower built on 15 power points per rank.

name: Second Chance
summary: Re-roll a failed check against one specific hazard and keep the better roll; take again for other hazards.

name: Sidekick
summary: A sidekick built on 5 power points per rank.

name: Teamwork
summary: +5 circumstance bonus when supporting a team check.

name: Trance
summary: Meditate into a deathlike trance that extends breath-holding and suspends poison and disease.

name: Agile Feint
summary: Feint using Acrobatics or your movement speed rank in place of Deception.

name: Animal Empathy
summary: Use interaction skills on animals normally, without a shared language.

name: Artificer
summary: Use Expertise (Magic) to build temporary magical devices.

name: Attractive
summary: +2 circumstance bonus to Deception and Persuasion with those who find you appealing (+5 at rank 2).

name: Connected
summary: Call in favors from your network with a Persuasion check.

name: Contacts
summary: Make your first Investigation check to gather information in just one minute.

name: Daze
summary: Use Deception or Intimidation as a standard action to daze a foe until the end of your next round; one skill per rank.

name: Fascinate
summary: Use an interaction skill to entrance an audience outside of combat; one skill per rank.

name: Favored Foe
summary: +2 circumstance bonus to Deception, Intimidation, Insight, and Perception against one type of opponent.

name: Hide in Plain Sight
summary: Hide while observed without a diversion or Stealth penalty.

name: Improvised Tools
summary: Ignore the penalty for lacking proper tools (only -2 with no tools at all).

name: Inventor
summary: Use Technology to create inventions.

name: Jack-of-all-trades
summary: Use any skill untrained.

name: Languages
summary: Know extra languages: 1 at rank 1, doubling with each further rank.

name: Ritualist
summary: Use Expertise (Magic) to devise and cast rituals.

name: Skill Mastery
summary: Make routine checks with one skill even under pressure; take again for other skills.

name: Startle
summary: Feint using Intimidation instead of Deception.

name: Taunt
summary: Demoralize using Deception instead of Intimidation.

name: Tracking
summary: Follow tracks visually with Perception.

name: Well-informed
summary: On first meeting a person or group, make an immediate Investigation or Persuasion check to know about them.

name: Acrobatic Defense
summary: Move at half speed acrobatically; an Acrobatics check grants +1 active defense per degree vs one foe (all foes at rank 2).

name: Action Surge
summary: After using extra effort for an action, try a Stamina check instead of spending a hero point to avoid exhaustion.

name: Active Disarm
summary: Disarm using Parry instead of attack, and trade up to 5 Parry for a disarm bonus.

name: Added Critical
summary: Critical hits with a chosen attack apply both Increased Effect and a fixed Added Effect.

name: Aggressive Driving
summary: +2 to Vehicles checks while the pursuer in a chase (+5 at rank 2).

name: Aggressive Escape
summary: Use a chosen attack against someone grabbing you to force them to let go.

name: Ambush
summary: +1 critical threat range per rank against unaware or surprised targets.

name: Armed Grab
summary: Grab with occupied hands at -2 (one hand full) or -5 (both).

name: Attack Specialist
summary: +2 initiative and +1 Parry in rounds you fight only with a chosen attack.

name: Bail Out
summary: Take reduced damage from vehicle crashes with a Dodge check.

name: Burn Rubber
summary: Your vehicle begins a chase a quarter faster than normal.

name: Cheap Shot
summary: Turn a successful feint into +1 damage per rank on the attack (once per foe per encounter).

name: Close-Quarters Battle
summary: +1 attack and initiative per rank with a chosen ranged attack against foes at short range.

name: Combo Element
summary: Make a chosen combat action or trait count as a Combo Action.

name: Countering Expert
summary: +2 to counter powers of a chosen descriptor (+5 with a second rank in it).

name: Crushing Hold
summary: Inflict Strength damage on a held foe as a free action each round, at -5 active defense.

name: Cunning Fighter
summary: Feint with your melee attack bonus instead of Deception.

name: Damaging Escape
summary: When you escape a grab, make a free unarmed attack on the grabber.

name: Dancing Combat
summary: Feint and trick with Expertise (Dancing) instead of Deception.

name: Daredevil
summary: After your successful pursuit maneuver, your pursuer must make a crash check at -2 (-5 at rank 2).

name: Dauntless
summary: Foes defending against a chosen attack take -2 to the defend action or Deflect (-5 at rank 2).
max_rank_note: Cap of 2 is per attack; buy separately for each attack.

name: Dedicated Defense
summary: Shift up to +5 active defense toward one attacker at an equal cost against all others.

name: Defensive Driving
summary: +2 to Vehicles checks while being chased (+5 at rank 2).

name: Defensive Strike
summary: +2 to your next close attack against a foe who missed you in melee (+5 at rank 2).

name: Defensive Throw
summary: Free trip attempt against a foe whose close attack misses you by 2+ degrees.

name: Demolition Derby
summary: When ramming, your vehicle counts as a quarter tougher and faster.

name: Devastating Hold
summary: Double the critical threat range when crushing a held foe with Strength damage.

name: Dirty Attack
summary: Add Dexterity to melee damage against prone foes.

name: Dirty Fighting
summary: +1 melee damage per rank when adjacent to a foe in cover or concealment or with hampered movement.

name: Distracting Attack
summary: Trade up to 5 points of attack damage for an equal bonus to aid an ally (aid becomes a move action).

name: Diverting Feint
summary: After two successful feints on a foe, a special attack can make them lose track of you.

name: Driving Instinct
summary: Insight check predicts a chase opponent's next maneuver for +4 on your opposing Vehicles check.

name: Duck and Cover
summary: Cover protects you better: -3/-7 to attacks against you and improved Dodge vs area effects.

name: Empowered Critical
summary: Critical hits with a chosen attack gain +2 more Increased Effect (+5 at rank 2).
max_rank_note: Cap of 2 is per attack; extra ranks may go to other attacks.

name: Entangling Feint
summary: A feinted foe who attacks you may tangle themselves up, becoming hindered and vulnerable.

name: Escapist
summary: On escaping someone's hold, release your own grab on them as a free action.

name: Favored Conditions
summary: +2 circumstance bonus to attack or active defenses under a chosen circumstance (outnumbered, drunk, cornered...).

name: Finesse Attack
summary: Use Dexterity in place of Strength for the damage of a chosen melee attack.

name: Finish Them
summary: Finishing attacks take one less action step.

name: First Strike
summary: +2 damage against surprised or unaware foes with lower initiative.

name: Flippant Disarm
summary: Control where a disarmed weapon lands: catch it, toss it to an ally, or hurl it; rank 2 works at range.

name: Follow-Up Strike
summary: After a melee critical hit, make a free extra attack on the same foe.

name: Grab Breaker
summary: Oppose a grab attempt with a chosen attack, adding its damage to your resistance.

name: Grabbing Parry
summary: After an unarmed defend (Parry) succeeds against a melee attack, start a grab as a free action.

name: Guard Weapon
summary: A smaller off-hand weapon grants +1 Parry, or a limited defend alongside your attack.

name: Gymkhana
summary: +2 on sliding, drifting, and obstacle maneuvers with a chosen ground vehicle type (+5 at rank 2).

name: Healing Touch
summary: Use Expertise (Biology) or Expertise (Martial Arts) on pressure points to grant Healing ranks by touch.

name: Healing Trance
summary: While in a Trance, an Awareness check speeds recovery from damage; once per day per rank.
requires_note: Prerequisite implied by the rules text rather than listed as a formal prerequisite.

name: Improved Assessment
summary: Use Assessment on one additional foe per rank at the same time.
requires_note: Prerequisite implied by the rules text rather than listed as a formal prerequisite.

name: Improved Charge
summary: Charges gain +1 damage per distance rank traveled (with possible self-damage).

name: Improved Concealment
summary: Concealment gives attackers -4 (partial) or -7 (total) against you.

name: Improved Covering Attack
summary: Covering attacks can impose -4 on a foe's attacks and skills and may earn a free extra attack.

name: Improved Disabling
summary: Disabling-critical threat range of a chosen attack widens by 1 per rank (to 16-20 at 4).

name: Improved Entangle Weapon
summary: +2 to entangle weapons and foes take -2 to counter-entangle you (+5/-5 at rank 2).

name: Improved Escape
summary: Escaping a grab with Acrobatics or Athletics is a free action.

name: Improved Exchange
summary: Raise the trade limit of a chosen trade-off advantage (Power Attack, Accurate Attack...) by 1 per rank.

name: Improved Joint Lock
summary: Attempt joint locks without the usual -2 penalty.
requires_note: Prerequisite implied by the rules text rather than listed as a formal prerequisite.

name: Improved Ranged Disarm
summary: Disarm at range without the usual -5 penalty.

name: Improved Readiness
summary: Ready a chosen attack without declaring its trigger in advance.

name: Improved Reversal
summary: +2 to grab checks made as a Reversal (+5 at rank 2).
requires_note: Prerequisite implied by the rules text rather than listed as a formal prerequisite.

name: Improved Tricking
summary: Trick with Deception as a move action.

name: Inviting Defense
summary: Trade up to 5 initiative for an equal bonus to Dodge and Parry.

name: Iron Liver
summary: +2 to resist alcohol and to fake being drunk (+5 at rank 2).

name: Joint Lock
summary: Allows the joint-lock grab option.

name: Just a Scratch
summary: Spend a hero point and pass a Fortitude check to shed one damage condition; once per session per rank.

name: Knockout
summary: A chosen attack that harms a foe forces a Fortitude check or leaves them dazed, stunned, or incapacitated.

name: Lie in Wait
summary: Take full actions during a planned ambush's surprise round.

name: Light Sleeper
summary: Wake easily and act at once on waking.

name: Mobile Defense
summary: +1 active defense per degree of success on your running Athletics check.

name: Mobile Offense
summary: +1 attack per degree on running checks, or +1 for moving at least your full speed.

name: Monkey Climber
summary: Climb with Acrobatics instead of Athletics when there are holds or surfaces to bound off.

name: Multi-Entangle
summary: Try to entangle several incoming weapons at once, -2 per extra weapon.

name: Multiattack Mastery
summary: Extra benefits when attacking with a Multiattack effect (bigger bonuses, smaller penalties, stronger cover fire).

name: Neck Breaker
summary: Lethal finishing attacks on a bound foe need fewer degrees of success.

name: Not So Helpless
summary: Fortitude check to lessen damage from a finishing attack.

name: Off-Putting Feint
summary: A successful feint also gives the foe -1 to attack and Perception for a round.

name: Parkour
summary: Make several jumps per round and catch yourself with Acrobatics instead of falling.

name: Pummel
summary: +2 effective damage for knockback only with a chosen attack (+5 at rank 2).
max_rank_note: Cap of 2 is per attack; extra ranks may go to other attacks.

name: Quick Strike
summary: Trade up to 5 damage for an equal initiative bonus.

name: Quick Throw
summary: After a successful grab, throw (trip) the foe as a free action.

name: Red Lining
summary: Push a vehicle category past its top speed with Vehicles checks, risking engine failure.

name: Reversal
summary: After escaping a grab, immediately try to grab the former grabber as a free action.

name: Steadfast
summary: Reduce knockback distance by one rank per rank.

name: Stuntman
summary: +2 on checks with a chosen pursuit maneuver (+5 at rank 2).

name: Superior Disabling
summary: Disabling criticals with a chosen attack are harder to treat (+2 DC) and last longer per rank.

name: Superior Entangle Weapon
summary: After parrying a melee weapon, make an entangle-weapon attempt as a free action.

name: Sweeping Strike
summary: Split an unarmed hit's damage into a bonus for a free trip attempt.

name: Take the Hit
summary: Forgo active defense against a melee attack; if it hits, make a free melee attack.

name: Unbalancing Strike
summary: Forgo damage on a melee hit to divide the foe's Dodge next round.

name: Vehicrobatics
summary: Use Vehicles in place of Acrobatics for stunts with a chosen vehicle type.

name: Vehicular Shield
summary: Vehicles check as a move action to have your vehicle absorb an attack aimed at you.

name: Acrobatic Fighter
summary: Add acrobatics to kicks or flying attacks for +1 damage or active defense per rank (Acrobatics check).

name: Aggressive Counter
summary: Countering a foe's effect leaves them vulnerable to your next attack.

name: Anticipation
summary: Opposed Insight check grants +2 active defense per degree against one foe.

name: Attack Mastery
summary: Raise one bonus that applies to your Attack Specialist attack by half.

name: Bob and Weave
summary: Fighting-style check as a move action grants +1 active defense per degree of success.

name: Bullet Time
summary: When using extra effort for an action, spend a hero point and roll for bonus move actions.

name: Counterstrike
summary: In rounds you don't attack, strike back free at foes who hit you in melee (one per rank, -2 cumulative).

name: Deceptive Attack
summary: Feint at -4 with a chosen attack to add Presence to the follow-up attack.

name: Deceptive Stance
summary: Disguise your stance: -4 per rank to foes reading it, +2 per rank to its DC.

name: Defensive Feint
summary: Feint using Parry or Dodge, halving that defense for the round.

name: Evasive Retreat
summary: Move up to 5 feet per rank whenever an attack misses you while defending.

name: Flowing Form
summary: Change stances as a free action at -5 DC.

name: Follow-Up Hard
summary: Chase a foe you knocked back and hit them again for free at -2.

name: Grappling Knee
summary: Pin a prone, grabbed foe with your knee to free your hands.

name: Hard Defense
summary: Defend with Toughness to blunt damage and gain attack bonuses against that foe.

name: Hard Grab
summary: Let a close attack land to make a free, unresisted grab on the attacker.

name: Hard Throw
summary: After a successful close trip, make a free throw at half damage bonus.

name: Iaijutsu
summary: The round you first draw a chosen weapon, use your fighting-style check in place of initiative.

name: Improved Prone Fighting
summary: +2 damage on close attacks while prone against a standing adjacent foe.

name: Improvised Weapon Element
summary: Use almost anything as a style weapon at -4 attack and -2 initiative.

name: Kata
summary: +2 active defense in rounds you use the style's maneuvers in a non-Neutral stance; one style per rank.

name: Kata Lore
summary: +4 to one of the style's skills while your Kata bonus is active.

name: Know Your Enemy
summary: +2 initiative against users of a style you hold Opposing Style for.

name: Living Weapon
summary: A chosen unarmed attack deals slashing or piercing damage.

name: Martial Balance
summary: In a style stance, use your fighting-style skill (at -2) for balance and tumbling instead of Acrobatics.

name: Martial Defense
summary: Defend against armed attacks unarmed with no penalty (matters only under the optional unarmed-defense rule).

name: Mobile Trance
summary: Move while in a trance with an Awareness check each round.
requires_note: Only useful with Trance or Healing Trance.

name: Offensive Defense
summary: Meet an incoming close attack with a readied attack at -4 to defend and hit at once.

name: Opposing Style
summary: Recognize a chosen rival style and gain +2 to attack and stance checks against it.

name: Passing Attack
summary: Keep moving after a charge attack, at -2 to hit.

name: Preferred Stance
summary: Boost one benefit of a favored stance by half, or halve one of its drawbacks.

name: Shattering Blow
summary: +50% damage against objects with a chosen attack.

name: Soft Defense
summary: Accept half damage from a defended close attack to act against the attacker at once.

name: (Style) Initiate
summary: First tier of a fighting style: +2 to the style's related non-attack skill checks.
requires_note: Needs 1 rank in each style skill, all style flaws, one non-martial-arts style advantage, and one basic maneuver.

name: (Style) Student
summary: Second tier of a fighting style: +2 attack with the style's basic and advanced maneuvers.
requires_note: Also half the style's skills at listed ranks, all extras and flaws, half its advantages, half its basic maneuvers, and one advanced maneuver.

name: (Style) Master
summary: Final tier of a fighting style: one free re-roll on a style-related check per session per rank (max Awareness).
requires_note: Also all the style's skills, extras, flaws, advantages, and maneuvers at listed ranks.

name: (Style) Stances
summary: Use the non-Neutral stances of a fighting style you practice; one style per rank.

name: Stylistic Teamwork
summary: +2 to aid bonuses for allies using a style you have reached Initiate in.

name: Up In Your Face
summary: Share a foe's space for +2 Toughness and close attack against them; they get +4 to grab you.

name: Warrior's Trance
summary: Spend a hero point and pass Awareness checks to get the extra-effort action benefit without fatigue.

name: Weapon Element
summary: Add one weapon per rank to a fighting style's usable weapons.
